scenarioName: Malformed message degrades to Unknown, no mutation
description: A hostile/gibberish message the parser cannot interpret produces no list change and leaves the existing list intact.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON reply that reports nothing was understood and leaves the list unchanged.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: An all-Unknown parse must not mutate the list and must say nothing was understood.

scoring.passCriteria: Reply reports no grocery changes and the existing milk item is preserved.
